scope: Deterministic engineering tests of work merged on develop. Not native-host observation, release evidence, owner review or a compatibility claim.
refresh_note: 2026-11-04 (record PR for 0.1.0-alpha.7): PR #1030 changed tests/test_opencode_entry.py, tests/test_plugin_opencode.py and tests/test_plugin_mcp.py (seven skills, doctor ancestor-skill scan, AIM validation message). Their sha256 values, the seven-skill wording and the test_plugin_opencode count (22 to 25) were refreshed after rerunning these three modules at 0eb75d84 (macOS arm64, CPython 3.13, test_plugin_mcp in a scratch venv with the pinned mcp SDK): 22 + 25 + 51 tests passed, no skips. The other modules were not rerun; their file hashes are unchanged on develop.
environment: macOS arm64, CPython 3.13.11, python -m unittest <module>; fake opencode/codex/claude executables; no model provider. test_plugin_mcp ran in a scratch venv with the pinned mcp==2.3.0 SDK (requirements-native-plugin.txt, hash-checked) so its SDK-gated test did not skip; the other modules ran in .venv-speckit.
result: All listed modules passed with no skips: 22 + 25 + 41 + 1 + 13 + 24 + 51 tests. CI on each merged PR is the pr-profile evidence for its head.

SC-003.outcome: OpenCode entry module (tests/test_opencode_entry.py, 22 tests): source parse finds none of the forbidden APIs and each forbidden API inserted into a copy is detected; registered values follow the contract; one server, seven skills and two commands; repeated transforms are idempotent; a foreign agent-braid server and existing skills are never replaced, updated or removed; a broken host context never throws.
SC-003.limits: Unit tests of the entry module with a synthetic host context. The MCP core results are the unchanged SPEC-046 tests (test_plugin_mcp); no stdio fixture drives the entry's registered command, and the real host starting the server is T010 (unobserved).

SC-004.outcome: plugin doctor --host opencode reports collision, duplicate-guidance, server-collision and ambiguous-configuration on fixture trees; output without --host unchanged; the entry registers seven skills and the setup and reconnect commands.
SC-004.limits: Fixture skill trees and a fake registry; the precedence order between some discovery locations was not compared on the host (T002 row 02). Live skill listing in a session is unobserved (T010).

SC-005.outcome: agent-braid-reconnect prompts the session with the operator steps and performs no reload; no automatic reload path exists in the entry (source parse).
SC-005.limits: Fixture only. reconnectRequired semantics are SPEC-046 and unchanged; reconnect in a live OpenCode session is unobserved (T010).

SC-006.outcome: Legacy lifecycle on isolated JSONC destinations (install, update, uninstall, plugin legacy migration from an OpenCode receipt) and install.sh --host opencode / all with fake executables leave documented state.
SC-006.limits: Fake host executables and isolated destinations. Native add/update/remove was observed once in the T002 matrix (local Git source, OpenCode 2.1.4, macOS arm64); the published-plugin lifecycle is T010.

SC-007.outcome: install.sh accepts --host opencode and all (absent hosts skipped with a notice, none found refused, --host opencode refuses when absent), prints the specified commands under --dry-run, and leaves Codex/Claude command output unchanged.
SC-007.limits: Fake executables. install.sh --host all and --host opencode fail at the OpenCode step against the real plugin-dist until 0.1.0-alpha.7 is published.

SC-008.outcome: The opencode legacy profile writes only the owned entry, keeps comments and foreign bytes, is idempotent, refuses ambiguous_configuration, unowned_collision and changed_digest, rolls back a failed write, and Codex/Claude previews and receipts stay byte-identical (golden test).
SC-008.limits: Isolated destinations; no real OpenCode configuration touched. The profile was not exercised by a running OpenCode.

SC-009.outcome: Envelopes, telemetry and stores are identical with and without the session identifier (SDK-gated test ran, no skip), the negative-control scan finds a stored identifier, and telemetry vocabularies and log-audit classes are unchanged (PluginOpenCodeSessionIdentifierTests, 3 tests); the rest of test_plugin_mcp (51 tests) passes.
SC-009.limits: Synthetic _meta key; whether OpenCode 2.1.4 sends a session identifier is a T002 row. The SDK-gated test needs the optional pinned mcp SDK and skips without it (it skips in .venv-speckit).

SC-010.outcome: The native build emits the OpenCode package (package.json without dependencies, opencode/index.js), extends inventory and provenance, and the files Codex and Claude read are byte-identical to a build without the OpenCode target (D12); package-name, dependency and drift negative controls.
SC-010.limits: Build fixture on this machine; clean-clone reproduction and the published tag are T011.
